name: Bulgaria

elections.note: Run-off between Iliana Iotova and Andrey Gyurov. First round 25 October 2026 (CIK, 99.94% of ballots): Iotova 34.8%, Gyurov 31.9%.
elections.noteIs: Seinni umferð milli Iliönu Iotovu og Andrey Gyurov. Fyrri umferð 25. október 2026 (CIK, 99,94% kjörgagna): Iotova 34,8%, Gyurov 31,9%.

leaders: President Iliana Iotova; Prime Minister Rumen Radev (Progressive Bulgaria)
leadersIs: Iliana Iotova forseti; Rumen Radev forsætisráðherra (Framsækin Búlgaría)
summary: Iliana Iotova, backed by Prime Minister Rumen Radev, led the first round on 25 October with 34.8% against 31.9% for the pro-EU reformist Andrey Gyurov (CIK, 99.94% of ballots), so the two meet in a run-off on 1 November. Turnout was a record low of 22.5%, according to Alpha Research.
summaryIs: Iliana Iotova, sem Rumen Radev forsætisráðherra styður, var efst í fyrri umferðinni 25. október með 34,8% en Evrópusinnaði umbótamaðurinn Andrey Gyurov fékk 31,9% (CIK, 99,94% kjörgagna), svo þau mætast í seinni umferð 1. nóvember. Kjörsókn var 22,5% samkvæmt Alpha Research, sú minnsta frá upphafi.

lastElection.outcome: No candidate won a majority; with 99.94% of ballots processed, CIK figures put Iliana Iotova on 34.8% and Andrey Gyurov on 31.9%, with Kostadin Kostadinov third; Alpha Research put turnout at a record low of 22.5%.
lastElection.outcomeIs: Enginn frambjóðandi fékk meirihluta; þegar 99,94% kjörgagna höfðu verið talin var Iliana Iotova með 34,8% og Andrey Gyurov 31,9% samkvæmt CIK, en Kostadin Kostadinov varð þriðji; Alpha Research áætlaði kjörsókn 22,5%, þá minnstu frá upphafi.
